we formulate the image captioning problem as a multimodal translator, and we present a sequence to sequence RNN model to address this problem, and we further introduce a multimodal attention to leverage the visual information in the sequential representation of images.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by formulating image captioning as multimodal translation and representing the image as a sequence, the performance of image captioning can be improved significantly.
, by using a sequence-to-seq model, the image can be naturally represented by a sequential object features, which can be further used for generating sentences in a translation way.
